name: Guard Spec: chat through the gateway

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: baseUrl: the gateway (GUARDSPEC_BASE_URL), without /v1. From n8n in Docker, the gateway on the host is http://host.docker.internal:8080. model: a model your upstream serves.

nodes.name: Guard Spec (HTTP Request)
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name Authorization, value Bearer gs_... (GUARDSPEC_API_KEY). Never Error is on, so a block (HTTP 400) reaches the next node instead of failing the run.

nodes.name: Basic LLM Chain
nodes.notes: On error: continue. A block arrives as an item with an error field instead of stopping the workflow.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model (gateway)
nodes.notes: OpenAI credential: API Key gs_... (GUARDSPEC_API_KEY), Base URL http://host.docker.internal:8080/v1 (GUARDSPEC_BASE_URL + /v1). Use Responses API is off: the gateway serves chat completions.
